description: This bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of the NatSQL model across different query complexities and a total average. The horizontal axis represents the query complexity categories: “Simple”, “Moderate”, “Challenging”, and “Total”, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Execution Accuracy”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Four bars are present, each corresponding to a query complexity category. The “Simple” bar is light blue and extends to a value of 60.21. The “Moderate” bar is a lighter shade of blue and reaches a value of 48.60. The “Challenging” bar is also a lighter shade of blue, extending to 51.35. Finally, the “Total” bar is light blue and reaches a value of 56.19. The shortest bar corresponds to the “Challenging” category with a value of 32.32, while the tallest bar corresponds to the “Simple” category with a value of 63.14. The bars are not visually emphasized beyond their color and height, and are arranged in order of increasing query complexity, with the “Total” bar appearing last.
